accepted: R1-6+7 wo/w_down epilogue residual add + SDPA concat heads
R2-1 permute-free group attention with same-slot mask (multivariate -44 %)

configs.precision_accuracy: bf16 weights/activations, HiFi2 matmuls with fp32_dest_acc_en, HiFi4 norms/RoPE/patch encoder, fp32 decoder output + monotone head
configs.precision_performance: bfp8 weights, LoFi, fp32 dest acc; wo/w_down fall back to matmul + add
configs.attention: SDPA output_concat_heads=True; group attention as SDPA over a series' tokens with additive same-slot mask, k_chunk <= 128
configs.qk_norm_rope: wan_fused_rmsnorm_pre/post_allgather on per-head view, RoPE tables cached per (R, S)

named_limitations: paper-performance (bfp8/LoFi) is slower than accuracy (588.8 vs 516.7 ms): the residual-epilogue matmul does not take bfp8 weights, so wo/w_down fall back to matmul + add
rows padded 66 -> 96 per series (45 % padding) in time attention; compacting costs more in repacking than it saves (R2-6 micro)

non-matmul ops ~47 % of device time (LayerNorm, RoPE, create_heads, SDPA); matmuls at ~29 % weighted peak FLOPs (iter_02/analysis.md; measured on the iter_02 code, before R2-1 and R2-3; not re-measured)
SDPA with a user mask over 768 keys is wrong at k_chunk 256 (PCC 0.985), right at 128 (jobs 582, 584)
host prepare ~100 ms of the 673 ms steady wall (CPU scaler, float64)
